memories.text:
Almost all prompting ‘technique’ is fake and a waste of time

It is almost strictly worse than just asking clearly for what you want.

Building a better library of reference material is an infinitely better use of your time than any prompting technique refinement.
a centralized payments processor skimming 3% off the top will be crucial for superintelligent exchanges of value, as we all know
